title: Evaluating the Generation Capabilities of Chinese Large Language Models
reasoning: The paper introduces a new benchmark (CG-Eval) for evaluating Chinese LLMs across various academic and professional domains including science, engineering, humanities, mathematical computation, medical, judicial, and accounting exams. While 'Humanities and Social Sciences' includes 'Philosophy', the benchmark does not specifically evaluate or benchmark religion, morals, or ethics as core components. The focus is on accuracy and relevance of generated text in factual and problem-solving contexts within these subjects.
